instruction: Buy me the cheapest safety goggles on amazon that will reach my home within 3 days. My payment cards do not have any money. So please transfer the minimum required money for the order from venmo to a card first.
notes: The product is modeled as a single runtime object cheapest-safety-goggles; the static fact (target-product p safety-goggles days-3) encodes the selection rule 'cheapest product of type safety goggles with delivery_days <= 3', which the agent applies to the price-sorted search results (assumed to include delivery_days; otherwise amazon.show_product can confirm it). The physical card is represented by two records, amazon-card and venmo-card, linked by (same-card ...) because the ids differ per app and must be matched by card_number. amazon.show_cart reveals the order total (order-total), which is the exact amount withdrawn from venmo so the venmo balance drops by order.paid_amount. add_product_to_cart uses quantity=1 and clear_cart_first=true to guarantee a single-item order (cart changes are ignored by the evaluation). Goal conditions are nullary (money-transferred, order-placed) so supervisor-complete-task can require them directly; the right product, home address and funded card are enforced by the preconditions of amazon-place-order.
